candidate.background_need: Fictional vocational teams in Finland and Sweden teach similar repair skills separately but lack a structured mechanism to share learning outcomes.

objectives.description: Establish a twelve-month shared learning pilot where Finnish and Swedish teams co-design and deliver a joint repair module.

expected_results.description: Completion of a jointly delivered repair module with documented mutual skill acquisition by both teams.

proposed_indicators.description: Number of distinct repair techniques successfully taught and assessed by the partner team during the pilot.
